method: NASA CMR granule search (public, no login) per collection and bounding box, grouped by STACK_ID (track_direction_frame) and polarization token. Counts are catalog records, not downloaded or inspected pixels.

regions.name: Sudd wetlands, South Sudan
regions.best_stack_footprint_note: Frame 5 of ascending track 86 spans about 29.2-31.9 E, 5.5-8.2 N and contains the Bahr el Jebel swamp core.
regions.best_stack_repeats: 9 dual-pol HH+HV (DHDH) + 1 single-pol HH (SHSH), all CRID P05023, 2026-06-20 to 2026-10-18, 12-day cycle with the 2026-08-07 repeat missing (documented instrument gap).
regions.decision: SELECTED by the human team on 2026-11-14

regions.name: Cuvette Centrale, Congo Basin
regions.best_stack_repeats: About 22 DHDH PROVISIONAL records Nov 2025-Mar 2026 and Jun-Oct 2026 (CRID P05023) plus BETA (X05009) records; longest series found.

regions.name: Okavango Delta, Botswana
regions.best_stack_repeats: 9 DHDH PROVISIONAL 2026-06-26 to 2026-10-12 plus BETA records; 100_A_167/168 frames only clip the western edge of the delta.

regions.name: Mississippi River Delta, USA (earlier preference, withdrawn by team)
regions.notable: VALIDATED same-stack pair exists: 156_D_073, 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-04 (CRID P05036, mode 4005, DHDH).
regions.decision: Withdrawn by team decision (master prompt update v2.1); recorded for transparency only

caveat: Counts can change as ASF ingests new products or reprocesses older ones (a 2027 reprocessing campaign is announced for pre-2026-10-21 data).
